with categories as ( select '서울특별시' as gramt, 1 as od union all select '부산광역시' as gramt, 2 as od union all select '대구광역시' as gramt, 3 as od union all select '인천광역시' as gramt, 4 as od union all select '광주광역시' as gramt, 5 as od union all select '대전광역시' as gramt, 6 as od union all select '울산광역시' as gramt, 7 as od union all select '세종특별자치시' as gramt, 8 as od union all select '경기도' as gramt, 9 as od union all select '충청북도' as gramt, 10 as od union all select '충청남도' as gramt, 11 as od union all select '전라남도' as gramt, 12 as od union all select '경상북도' as gramt, 13 as od union all select '경상남도' as gramt, 14 as od union all select '강원특별자치도' as gramt, 15 as od union all select '전북특별자치도' as gramt, 16 as od union all select '제주특별자치도' as gramt, 17 as od union all select '소계' as gramt, 18 as od ) SELECT decode(cs.gramt,'소계','합계',cs.gramt) as GRAMT, nvl(yp.tnocs, 0) as TNOCS, nvl(yp.asum, 0) as ASUM, trunc(cast(nvl(yp.tnocs_rt, 0) as numeric(5,1)),1) as TNOCSRT, trunc(cast(nvl(yp.asum_rt, 0) as numeric(5,1)),1) as ASUMRT FROM categories cs LEFT JOIN ( SELECT psint_upper_locgov_nm as gramt, sum(tnocs) as tnocs, sum(asum) as asum, sum(tnocs_rt) as tnocs_rt, sum(asum_rt) as asum_rt FROM YEAR_PSINT_AMT_TNOCS where 1=1 and crtr_yr = #{shYear} and upper_locgov_code = #{shWdr} and locgov_code = #{shLocgovCode} group by psint_upper_locgov_nm, psint_upper_locgov_code order by psint_upper_locgov_code, FRST_REG_DT ) yp on cs.gramt = yp.gramt ORDER BY cs.od

with locgovinfo as ( select * from ( select * from stat_locgov order by locgov_code ) union all select '소계' as locgov_code , '소계' as locgov_nm , '소계' as upper_locgov_code , '소계' as upper_locgov_nm ) select lg.upper_locgov_nm , lg.upper_locgov_code , lg.locgov_nm , lg.locgov_code , nvl(yp.GRAMT, lg.upper_locgov_nm || ' ' || lg.locgov_nm) as GRAMT , nvl(yp.TNOCS,0) as TNOCS , nvl(yp.TNOCSRT,0) as TNOCSRT , nvl(yp.ASUM,0) as ASUM , nvl(yp.ASUMRT,0) as ASUMRT from locgovinfo lg left join ( SELECT case when PSINT_UPPER_LOCGOV_NM = '소계' then '합계' else PSINT_UPPER_LOCGOV_NM || ' ' || PSINT_LOCGOV_NM end AS GRAMT, TNOCS , TNOCS_RT as TNOCSRT, ASUM , ASUM_RT as ASUMRT, psint_locgov_code FROM YEAR_PSINT_AMT_TNOCS WHERE 1=1 AND CRTR_YR = #{shYear} AND UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE = #{shWdr} AND LOCGOV_CODE = #{shLocgovCode} ORDER BY PSINT_UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE )yp on lg.locgov_code = yp.psint_locgov_code
